name: Feed the Cat
source:
When the girl she's dating needs an emergency cat sitter, Claire jumps to volunteer. After all, what could go wrong with pet sitting an adorable little cat for one night? 

[From [url=https://thom-is-trans.itch.io/feed-the-cat]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当她约会的女孩需要一名紧急猫保姆时，克莱尔立即去做志愿者。毕竟，让宠物照顾一只可爱的小猫一晚会有什么问题呢？

[来自[url=https://thom-is-trans.itch.io/feed-the-cat]Itch.io[/url]]
